Context: 7. Calculation of Pension

In no case, a pension (including compassionate allowance), granted shall be less than z 9,000 per mensem.  
For all classes of pension (including compassionate allowance), the method of determination of pension is the same. - Rule 44.  
Besides, additional quantum of pension shall be payable as and when the pensioner attains the age of 80 years and above as detailed below:- Additional pension shall be paid from the first day of the month in - Rule 44 (6).
